I am 62 years old, I have a primary school education, and I have farmed my land in Quzhou for 40 years. I know every corner of my 15 mu. I work alone, but I hire two people for wheat harvest and for stevia drying because at my age I cannot do everything myself.

My 10 mu of wheat was planted last October. I use an improved variety, the same one my neighbor Lao Zhang uses. For base fertilizer I put 100 jin of 15-15-15 compound fertilizer per mu, which cost 160 yuan per bag. This spring at green-up I top-dressed with 40 jin of urea per mu. That is about 17 kg of nitrogen per mu total, plus 8 kg phosphorus and 8 kg potassium. I already did the overwintering irrigation last winter. I will irrigate two more times, at jointing and at heading. I spray pesticide twice — once with herbicide and once when I see aphids. I rotary tilled before planting last fall. I expect 550 kg per mu, about the same as last year.

After wheat harvest in early June, I plant summer maize on those same 10 mu. I buy hybrid seed from the input dealer in town, 3 kg per mu for 45 yuan. I put 100 jin of compound fertilizer per mu at planting, and 50 jin of urea at the big trumpet stage. That comes to about 19 kg nitrogen per mu, 8 kg phosphorus, and 8 kg potassium. I irrigate twice — once right after planting if it does not rain, and once at tasseling. I spray twice, herbicide at planting and insecticide if corn borers show up. I rotary till after wheat harvest. Expected yield is 600 kg per mu. I have done this wheat-maize rotation for 20 years and I do not change it.

My 5 mu of stevia I plant with improved seedlings in late April. The buyer from Shandong comes every autumn, so I know the market is there. I put 80 jin of compound fertilizer per mu as base, then top-dress twice with 15 jin of urea each time. I also add 20 jin of potassium chloride per mu because the input dealer told me stevia needs extra potassium for sweeter leaves. Total nitrogen is about 13 kg per mu, phosphorus is 6 kg, and potassium is 10 kg. I irrigate four times — planting water, and then once every month in the summer because stevia drinks more than maize. I spray three times for insects, leaf-eating worms love stevia leaves and I cannot sell damaged leaves. I rotary till before planting. Expected dry leaf yield is 250 kg per mu.

Total input cost for all 15 mu is about 4,500 yuan. That is a lot of money for one old man, but I learned my lesson in 2013 when I tried to save 500 yuan on fertilizer and lost half my maize to poor grain fill. I would rather waste some fertilizer than risk a disaster. I watch what my successful neighbors do, and most of them use similar amounts. When I am not sure, I do what I did last year. Change is risky at my age, and I have no one to help me recover from a bad mistake.
